vetSays.line: 🛡️ Gabriel, Natalie, Marcela, Hendar and Ursula met them at the door — 5 put down. Gabriel, Natalie, Marcela, Hendar, Ursula are hurt.
🛡️ Gabriel, Francesca, Marcela, Zoe and Ursula met them at the door — 5 put down. Gabriel, Francesca, Marcela, Zoe, Ursula are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Gabriel, Natalie, Marcela, Ursula and Mateo met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 barely walked away. Gabriel, Natalie, Marcela, Ursula, Mateo are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ursula just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Gabriel, Marcela, Ursula and Nino met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Gabriel, Marcela, Ursula, Nino are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Marcela just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📓 Codex: you've heard of Cold-Blooded. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
◈ THE SYSTEM has been watching Marcela — Craft 1. Three offers; they took Cold-Blooded. Earned, chosen. (cold_blooded: villager level-up)
📓 Codex: Marcela chose Cold-Blooded (cold_blooded) at Craft 1.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Marcela just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ursula just put down The Ugly Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Nino just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Marcela, Zoe, Ursula and Nino met them at the door — 4 put down. Marcela is hurt.
🛡️ Wanjiru and Arsen met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off. Wanjiru, Arsen are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wanjiru just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Davide, Wanjiru and Arsen met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Davide, Arsen are hurt.
🪞 You wake up somebody else. Marcela Villa, 29 — an HVAC tech. Her hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Cold-Blooded, Scream Cheese.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Davide just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Davide, Wanjiru, Arsen and Liam met them at the door — 1 put down, 3 barely walked away. Wanjiru, Arsen, Liam are hurt.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
